name: flaggems_special_erfinv
description: Inverse error function (aten.special_erfinv) applied elementwise. Input must lie in (-1, 1); the correctness generator draws uniform values in [-0.9, 0.9]. FP16/BF16 inputs are computed in float32 then cast back, matching the FlagGems correctness pytest. Timing uses UnaryPointwiseBenchmark's generic randn inputs (workload type random).
